settings.selection: MoE prefix and elapsed steps only; no task ID, object pose, outcome, or future frames
settings.training: all previous 150 mains and paired fixed-operator outcomes; task-isolated cross-validation
settings.reference_weight: each main has total weight one; no chunk-wise train/test split
settings.projection: weighted standardized covariance PCA; eight whitened coordinates
settings.shuffle: deterministic derangement of pre-treatment choices, exact operator counts per repeat
settings.missing: zero-filled normalized components with five explicit validity indicators

diagnostics.caveat: Tail scores are retrospective diagnostics, not early alarms; task-isolated folds refit all preprocessing
